links.outcome: Readability (Gunning Fog Index) of ChatGPT-4o patient-directed responses on POIS across two days
links.effect: Readability scores worsened significantly from Day 1 to Day 2 across all domains (p < 0.05), indicating more linguistically complex, less accessible language.
links.quote: Readability scores worsened significantly from Day 1 to Day 2 across all domains (p < 0.05), indicating a shift toward more linguistically complex, less accessible language.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT-4o answers to identical questions submitted on two days
links.effect: 100% reproducibility (κ = 1.00) in epidemiology and counseling; lower reproducibility (κ = 0.25) in treatment and risk domains.
links.quote: However, accuracy dropped to 50% in the treatment and risk domains, with lower reproducibility (κ = 0.25).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o's performance (accuracy, reproducibility, readability) on answering patient questions about Post-Orgasmic Illness Syndrome across multiple domains without testing a specific implementation or deployment safeguard.
